title: Ukraine's drone attacks severely damaged three of Yandex's six data centers, disrupting Russia's tech ecosystem, centered on one vast, state-aligned company (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Ukraine's drone attacks severely damaged three of Yandex's six data centers, disrupting Russia's tech ecosystem, centered on one vast, state-aligned company — Kyiv's attacks exposed vulnerabilities of Kremlin effort to centralise internet services under one company
